result.topic_en: Gauss expresses triangle areas of a figure with points 0, 1, II, III, IV as sums of numbered partial areas, writes the linear (barycentric) relations among the points with these areas as coefficients, and determines the unknown partial areas, also directly from earlier equations (2) and (5).
